items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the play 'Twin Melodies', and answer.

"MEERA: (holding two letters) One says the music school has chosen me. The other says I'm in the state hockey team. Both camps start on the same day.
DADI: (putting down her knitting) And which letter did you open first?
MEERA: The music one. (pause) Oh.
DADI: (smiling) Sometimes our hands answer before our heads do."

What does Dadi mean by "Sometimes our hands answer before our heads do"?
items.answer: Meera's instinct (opening the music letter first) shows what she truly wants.
items.markingKey: Meera's instinct (opening the music letter first) shows what she truly wants. (1–2 marks for a complete answer.)

items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the play 'Twin Melodies', and answer.

"MEERA: (holding two letters) One says the music school has chosen me. The other says I'm in the state hockey team. Both camps start on the same day.
DADI: (putting down her knitting) And which letter did you open first?
MEERA: The music one. (pause) Oh.
DADI: (smiling) Sometimes our hands answer before our heads do."

Answer the following:
(i) What do the two letters say?
(ii) Why is Meera in a dilemma?  (a) Dadi is angry  (b) Both camps start on the same day  (c) She dislikes music  (d) She has lost both letters
(iii) Find a stage direction in the extract.  (a) "Oh."  (b) "And which letter did you open first?"  (c) (holding two letters) / (putting down her knitting) / (pause) / (smiling)  (d) "Both camps start on the same day."
(iv) What role does Dadi play in the scene?  (a) A supporter who gently helps Meera understand her own choice  (b) A judge who punishes  (c) A rival  (d) A stranger
items.answer: (i) One says she has been chosen by the music school; the other that she is in the state hockey team. (ii) (b) Both camps start on the same day (iii) (c) (holding two letters) / (putting down her knitting) / (pause) / (smiling) (iv) (a) A supporter who gently helps Meera understand her own choice
items.markingKey: (i) One says she has been chosen by the music school; the other that she is in the state hockey team. (ii) (b) Both camps start on the same day (iii) (c) (holding two letters) / (putting down her knitting) / (pause) / (smiling) (iv) (a) A supporter who gently helps Meera understand her own choice (1 mark each, 4 marks.)
